## GPU-resident Krylov solves for FieldVector states

`KrylovMethod` previously had no GPU-correct workspace for ClimaCore
`FieldVector` states: CPU workspace vectors leaked into the `jvp!` broadcast,
causing scalar indexing and significant GPU slowdown

- Keep the Krylov workspace flat and on-device (`Krylov.ktypeof(::FieldVector)`
  from ClimaCore's `KrylovExt`), translating with a new `KrylovVectorAdapter`: 
  allocation-free block-wise copies around each
  JVP/preconditioner application (via the new
  `ClimaTimeSteppersClimaCoreExt` (ClimaCore weakdep).
- Plain-vector states keep the existing zero-copy path.
- Simplify `ForwardDiffStepSize3` to `length(x) + sum(abs, x)` (equivalent, and
  already GPU-safe via ClimaCore's `mapreduce`).
- Add a Newton–Krylov FieldVector test

Requires ClimaCore ≥ 0.15; merge after its release.

Performance comparison for RICO on A100 GPU, direct solve (baseline) vs Krylov (with dev version of ClimaCore and this branch):

Component / Function | Direct Solve Calls | Direct Solve Time (median) | Direct Solve Allocs (Memory) | Krylov Solve Calls | Krylov Solve Time (median) | Krylov Solve Allocs (Memory) | Difference / Notes
-- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | --
step! (Total Time) | 1 | 5.67 ms | 3,296 (784.6 KiB) | 1 | 5.24 ms | 4,084 (331.1 KiB) | ~8% faster, 58% less memory
ldiv! | 2 | 281.9 μs | 480 (19.9 KiB) | 4 | 578.4 μs | 960 (39.8 KiB) | 2 extra preconditioner solves
Wfact! | 2 | 746.0 μs | 208 (83.4 KiB) | 2 | 674.3 μs | 208 (83.4 KiB) | ~72 μs faster
T_imp! | 2 | 907.6 μs | 874 (225.8 KiB) | 4 | 1.78 ms | 1,748 (451.7 KiB) | 2 extra matrix-free JVP calls
T_exp! | 2 | 176.7 μs | 730 (69.1 KiB) | 2 | 177.4 μs | 730 (69.1 KiB) | Equal
lim! | 3 | 126.0 ns | 0 (0 bytes) | 3 | 126.0 ns | 0 (0 bytes) | Equal
dss! | 7 | 287.0 ns | 0 (0 bytes) | 7 | 287.0 ns | 0 (0 bytes) | Equal
constrain_state! | 1 | 5.4 μs | 69 (6.0 KiB) | 1 | 5.3 μs | 69 (6.0 KiB) | Equal
initialize_imp! | 2 | 39.9 μs | 0 (0 bytes) | 2 | 39.4 μs | 0 (0 bytes) | Equal
cache! | 3 | 6.90 ms | 297 (11.5 KiB) | 3 | 6.75 ms | 297 (11.5 KiB) | ~150 μs faster
cache_imp! | 2 | 20.5 μs | 28 (1.2 KiB) | 4 | 40.8 μs | 56 (2.4 KiB) | 2 extra calls for JVP
title: Avoid scalar indexing in Krylov solver
